messages:
alex: Opening a PR to switch overlays/staging from in-repo k8s Secrets to Secrets Manager paths + add KMS grant. Planning a canary promote instead of full promote.
sam: Good. Please attach `tf plan` in the PR and run preflight CI. We should gate against any SA or role `destroy` in the plan.
chetna: If this touches the inference-service IRSA role, do NOT change the role name. Old pods rely on that exact role ARN. Add new policy statements instead.
alex: Understood. Will keep the role name. Q: can I also add key rotation in this PR or should that be a separate change?
morgan: Separate PR for rotation. Rotation requires security signoff and a maintenance window. Keep this PR minimal: secrets path + IAM grant.
lucas: For gating, set `overlays/staging/patches/promote-canary: "true"` in kustomize and update `ci/release-gate` to run 10m smoke tests against canary before full roll.
alex: Draft kustomize snippet I'm planning to include (staging overlay):
```yaml
patches:
  - target:
      kind: Deployment
      name: inference-service
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/SECRETS_PATH/value
        value: "secretsmanager://redwood/projects/infra/paths/inference/staging"
```
sam: Add a dev-only fallback k8s Secret that CI can use if Secrets Manager IAM is temporarily unavailable.
infra-bot: terraform plan finished for `overlays/staging` — 2 to add, 3 to change, 0 to destroy. Plan: gs://tf-plans/redwood/1946789012.plan
alex: Attached plan to PR. Also added a preflight check to fail the run if any resource `destroy` touches service accounts.
morgan: Pinging @security for a quick review on the KMS grant. Don't merge without their ack.
security: Quick note 1: need to ensure the KMS grant is scoped to the deployer service account only and logs are enabled. We'll ack after we see the updated IAM snippet.
lucas: Release gate will auto-approve promote after canary smoke passes. If smoke fails, gate will roll back canary and block the promote. I'll add a step to post results to #incidents if rollback occurs.
deploy-bot: Canary promote scheduled for 2024-06-04T09:15:00Z (manual trigger required).
alex: I'll split the KMS key rotation into follow-up PR. This one stays scoped to: switching path references, adding IAM grant, adding canary flag, attaching tfplan and preflight checks. Thanks for the reviews everyone :thumbsup:
__note: This thread is stored as a single continuous message string; timestamps are unix-like and represent the root message time and bounds.
